note: Nottoway County GIS lists zoning as 'not currently available'. Its GIS layers (Nottoway_WL_D on ArcGIS Online, services9.arcgis.com) return 'Token Required'; the county GIS portal (nottowaycova.interactivegis.com) requires login. The county's zoning district page links only PDF maps. No public queryable zoning district service was found for Nottoway County; towns of Crewe, Blackstone and Burkeville publish zoning only as ordinances/PDFs or third-party maps.
